[quote=united_hydronia;59999559]The president speaks.

[i]Of course, we too wish to reach a new, fair agreement that will benefit us both after the unfortunate suspension of supplies[/i]

Minister Erdemir slides forward the same document as before listing Hydronias available resources.

[i]We are still happy to provide you with food, uranium and information of renewable energy systems, but due to the ongoing hostilities, we need assurances that the EDU wont exploit us, and you. To do this, wed like you to observe a limit on trade with the EDU. We understand that you cant just deny trade with them, but wed like to propose the following terms.

We provide you with uranium, foodstuffs and renewable energy technologies. You provide us with aluminium. Additionally, you would have to refuse to sell aluminium to any EDU member, but we will allow you to trade other commodities.[/i]

[i]what do you say?[/i] says the president.[/quote]

Minister Emam speaks first, "those terms seem agreeable to me."

Minister Jalayer speaks next, "I also think those terms are agreeable. A complete cutoff of trade with the EDU would have been quite difficult but restricting aluminum and permitting other trade has me relieved. We agree to your deal."
